test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions. Consider the statements and conclusions to be true even if they vary from commonly known facts and then decide which of the conclusions follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

1. All pens are bags.

2. Some bottles are pens.

3. All shoes are bottles.

**Conclusions:**

I. No bag is a shoes.

II. Some pens are shoes.

III. Some bags are shoes.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed8418854797bef9d1aad9c5d5dde3905455a8a7a424d7f29b0dbd47bf01cbcc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No bag is a shoe → Does not follow (As all pens are bags, some bottles are pens and all shoes are bottles. As no direct relation is given between shoes and bags, so it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some pens are shoes → Does not follow (As some bottles are pens and all shoes are bottles. So it is possible but not definite.)

III. Some bags are shoes → Does not follow (As all pens are bags, some bottles are pens and all shoes are bottles. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion follow.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
